config.processState: Fresh dedicated headless Chrome process/profile per case/run; HTTP cache disabled; OS caches not purged
config.timing: Enter capture starts submission intent. Focusout capture to document bubble follows the React root handler, including synchronous command preparation and domain validation. Adoption click is measured separately. MutationObserver waits for an increased completed-raster count and visible primary canvas, then two rAF callbacks.
limitations: event.timeStamp queue intervals begin at browser event creation, not physical input.
DOM/rAF intervals include observer and automation overhead; they are not GPU completion or physical screen presentation.
Gesture coalescing is explicit; multiple inputs may share one observed transform.
No runtime resource peak, cross-browser, free-object drag, or complete QA-PERF-01/04 claim.
高密度测量副本有大量真实尺寸物件相互覆盖，不是可玩地图布局或美术验收。
projectedPropCounts 是受众投影纳入数，propsWhollyInsideExport 是几何范围数；遮挡后的实际可见物件数未测。
源 PNG alpha 计数为实际文件像素；实例 alpha 面积按图像矩形缩放且重复计入交叠，不含阴影与合成后的可见覆盖。
rectangleGrid 以网格中心抽样旋转图像矩形，忽略源 alpha；不是精确并集，也不是内存或资源峰值。
保留原样板公开性；普通样板没有新增 GM 秘密，秘密差分回归另用 B4 配对夹具。
